_doc: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — nothing imports this file. It is a human-readable snapshot of the studio facts, kept so a reader can see them in one place. The bot does NOT read it: services (incl. price_ils) come from the Supabase `services` table at request time, and the rest is hardcoded in supabase/functions/_shared/bot-config.ts (SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE) and _shared/faq-engine.ts. Changing this file changes nothing at runtime — update those instead, then redeploy (bash scripts/deploy-functions.sh).
